title: BLS — Community Health Workers
evidence: May2025 national median $51,850; lowest10% below38,810; highest10% above77,180; growth13% 2025–35;7,000 annual openings. High school typical; full time, evenings/weekends; supervisory advancement.

title: National C3 Council — Roles and Competencies
evidence: Consensus roles include mediation, navigation, outreach, advocacy, education, coaching, community capacity and evaluation; professional conduct and communication skills. Reflective scenarios are author synthesis.

title: KDHE — Community Health Workers
evidence: Trusted community understanding, liaison to services, education, support, advocacy and community capacity; does not supply independent clinical authority.

title: O*NET — Community Health Workers
evidence: Records, follow-up, referrals, community meetings, provider feedback and navigation titles. Procedure examples in this broad catalog are NOT used as Kansas procedure authorization.

title: BLS Career Outlook — Interview with CHW Mikayla Trujillo, August 2022
evidence: First-person account supports qualitative rewards, crisis/secondary-trauma challenges, boundaries, community connection and varied work. Not population-wide statistical evidence; workday is illustrative.

title: Kansas CHW Coalition — Education
evidence: Core program 100 instructional hours and60 service-learning hours; specific providers organize hours differently.

title: KDHE — CHW Certification
evidence: Education, work experience and reciprocity pathways; work experience800h over3years plus3 recommendation letters; reciprocity subject to criteria.

title: KDHE — CHW Policy and Billing Guidance
evidence: Kansas Medicaid policy effective July1 2023; recognized certification and approved supervising practitioner for covered services; not universal law of all CHW employment. Excludes direct patient care beyond training/certification; article does not reproduce billing rates/limits.

title: Kansas CHW Coalition — Certification
evidence: Registry and certification administration. Temporary2026 renewal transition notice not included as evergreen student copy.

title: Indian Health Service — Community Health Representative
evidence: CHR is Tribal workforce improving access and capacity in AI/AN communities; does not establish all CHW titles as equivalent credentials.

title: BLS — Health Education Specialists
evidence: Program development/evaluation; at least bachelor degree typical. No educator wages borrowed for CHW.

title: BLS — Social Workers
evidence: Social-worker support role and clinical diagnosis/treatment distinction.

title: National Association of Community Health Workers — About
evidence: Membership organization; umbrella terminology, community trust/shared experience; professional development and advocacy.

title: Kansas CHW Coalition
evidence: Education, empowerment, professional advocacy and certification resources.
